```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
data <- read_csv("full-names-data-nice.csv")
```
```{r}
helperCor <- function(name_data, karen_data) {
  cor(name_data$prop, karen_data$prop, method = "kendall", use = "complete.obs")
}
```

```{r}
aylee_us_data <- data %>%
  filter(name == "Aylee", country == "United States", sex == "F")
  
aylee_scot_data <- data %>%
  filter(name == "Aylee", country == "Scotland", sex == "Girl")

##No correlation, no overlap in years

bella_us_data <- data %>%
  filter(name == "Bella",country == "United States",sex == "F")

bella_scot_data <- data %>%
  filter(name == "Bella",country == "Scotland",sex == "Girl") %>%
  filter(year == 2018:2024)

helperCor(bella_us_data, bella_scot_data)

## Corr = 0.52
  

```
